question: Whether Section B item 1's requirement to achieve cyanide effluent limitations by a completion date of 12 months after the permit effective date ('Achieve Final Effluent Limitations 12 months after permit effective date') makes those cyanide effluent limitations applicable enforceable numeric discharge limits for Federal FY2025 compliance comparison during periods before that scheduled date, or instead defers only the compliance-achievement deadline while the limitations remain applicable throughout.
semantic_arguments: Section B item 1: 'The permittee shall achieve compliance with the Cyanide effluent limitations specified for discharges in accordance with the following schedule'
Schedule activity: 'Achieve Final Effluent Limitations 12 months after permit effective date'
Permit effective date (needed to locate FY2025 relative to the 12-month schedule)
Interpretation of 'Final Effluent Limitations' in the schedule versus any interim or staged cyanide limits specified elsewhere in the permit
NPDES distinction between a schedule-of-compliance completion date and the temporal applicability of enforceable numeric effluent limits
notes: Purpose A requires identifying which enforceable numeric limits apply to each reported measurement in FY2025 and whether measurements exceed them. A schedule-only reading would exclude pre-deadline cyanide comparisons; a limits-apply-throughout reading would include them. The passage does not resolve which interpretation governs.
